battle.name: 波蘇戰爭
battle.theater: 波蘭東部與白俄羅斯戰線
battle.brief: 一九一九年二月十四日，波軍第四、第五軍攻入沃里尼亞羅夫諾，波蘇戰爭爆發。一九二〇年五月紅軍四路西進，八月十二日至二十五日兵鋒抵達華沙東郊，維斯瓦河會戰扭轉戰局，六十餘日內退回納曼河西岸。一九二一年三月十八日里加條約劃定邊界。海軍守住但澤與波羅的海航線，援助由此運抵前線。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 木殼外面包了鐵。裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。

countries: 交戰主體是波蘭第二共和國與蘇維埃俄國，前者稱波軍，後者稱紅軍，另有數方以武裝方式捲入。波蘭方面由國防部統轄，參謀總長塔德烏什·羅茲瓦多夫斯基主持作戰計畫，國家元首兼最高統帥約瑟夫·畢蘇斯基握有戰略主導權；野戰部隊按步兵師、騎兵師編制，另有地方國防民兵、輔助軍與志願兵大隊，並於一九二〇年把前奧匈與德國預備役中願入波軍的士兵編成補充師，動員總額接近一百萬人。蘇維埃方面，工農紅軍受共產黨中央軍事委員會與國防人民委員部雙重指揮，一九二〇年三月組建西南方面軍，前線分為第四軍、第二軍、第一騎兵軍、第三軍與第十二軍，分別指向華沙、利沃夫、盧布林、明斯克與基輔方向；蘇維埃烏克蘭與蘇維埃白俄羅斯以加盟者身份參戰，白俄羅斯境內的游擊隊與烏克蘭民族主義武裝則分立於兩大陣營之外。英國分遣隊以護航名義進駐波羅的海，把波蘭海軍置於本國旗影之下；法國哈勒爾使團與大批援助物資湧入，德國志願兵大隊亦參與立陶宛方向的作戰。波蘭內部亦有裂痕：一九二〇年五月，議會派企圖以改組內閣接管軍權，畢蘇斯基在華沙戒嚴應變，是為「五月危機」。
countriesEn: The main belligerents were the Second Polish Republic and Soviet Russia, the former fielding the Polish Army and the latter the Red Army, with several other parties pulled in by force of arms. On the Polish side the army was under the Ministry of Military Affairs, with Chief of the General Staff Tadeusz Rozwadowski in charge of operational planning and with the head of state and supreme commander Jozef Piłsudski holding the strategic initiative. Field forces were organised into infantry and cavalry divisions, alongside the Territorial Defence militia, auxiliary formations and volunteer brigades; in 1920 men drawn from the former Austro-Hungarian and German reserves who had taken Polish service were formed into supplementary units, and the total mobilisation came close to one million men. On the Soviet side the Workers' and Peasants' Red Army was under the dual control of the Central Military Committee of the Communist Party and the People's Commissariat for Military and Naval Affairs, and a Southwestern Front was created in March 1920, divided into the 4th Army, the 2nd Army, the 1st Cavalry Army, the 3rd Army and the 12th Army, pointed respectively at Warsaw, Lvov, Lublin, Minsk and Kiev. Soviet Ukraine and Soviet Belarus took part as constituent republics, while the partisans inside Belarus and the Ukrainian nationalist armed forces stood outside the two main camps. A British detachment entered the Baltic under the banner of escort duty, placing the Polish Navy under the protection of the British flag; a French mission led by General Haller and a flood of munitions followed, and a German volunteer brigade also fought on the Lithuanian front. There were fissures inside Poland as well: in May 1920 the parliamentary camp tried to seize power by reshuffling the cabinet, and Piłsudski's arming of Warsaw against the attempt is remembered as the May crisis.
people: 波蘭方面的關鍵人物集中在軍政兩層。約瑟夫·畢蘇斯基自一九一八年起主持建國，一九一九年十二月至一九二〇年三月一度退隱，復出後以全軍最高統帥身份主導一九二〇年攻勢，四月升任國家元首。他重用塔德烏什·羅茲瓦多夫斯基主持參謀作業，後者主張以楔形縱隊向紅軍側翼深插；愛德華·雷茲-希米格維指揮第五軍集團，是八月維斯瓦河會戰中扭轉戰局的關鍵。瓦迪斯瓦夫·西科爾斯基任軍事作戰局局長，參謀本部多數戰役方案出自他手；卡齊米日·索斯尼科夫斯基在一九一九年切申之戰中指揮波軍奪取切申，是波蘭與捷克斯洛伐克爭議的關鍵人物；盧茨揚·熱利戈夫斯基以代號「鐵」的行動奪取維爾納，把波軍邊界推入立陶宛腹地。外交方面，伊格納齊·達申斯基出任外交總長，揚·登布斯基率團赴里加談判，寇松勳爵的方案則劃出所謂寇松線。蘇維埃方面，列寧主持黨與國的大政方針，托洛茨基掌紅軍系統並力主以武裝干涉推動歐洲革命；米哈伊爾·圖哈切夫斯基指揮第四軍，負責華沙方向的主攻；亞歷山大·葉戈羅夫統率第三軍、謝爾蓋·加米涅夫指揮第二軍、謝苗恩·布瓊尼率第一騎兵軍在南線牽制。
peopleEn: The decisive figures on the Polish side divided into the military and the political. Jozef Piłsudski had run the country since the founding of the state in 1918; after withdrawing from public life between December 1919 and March 1920 he returned as commander-in-chief of the entire army and led the offensive of 1920, becoming head of state that April. He relied on Tadeusz Rozwadowski to run the general staff work, and Rozwadowski argued for driving wedge-shaped columns deep into the flanks of the Red Army. Edward Rydz-Smigly commanded the 5th Army group and was the key to turning the battle on the Vistula in August. Wladyslaw Sikorski served as director of military operations in the general staff, and most of the staff war plans were his work; Kazimierz Sosnkowski commanded the Polish forces that seized Cieszyn in the fighting of 1919, the decisive act in the quarrel with Czechoslovakia; and Lucjan Zeligowski took Vilnius in the operation code-named Zelazo, pushing the Polish border deep into the Lithuanian interior. On the diplomatic stage Ignacy Daszynski became foreign minister, Jan Debski led the delegation to Riga for the peace talks, and Lord Curzon's twelve points defined what came to be called the Curzon Line. On the Soviet side Lenin set the line of party and state policy, Trotsky ran the Red Army system and pressed for armed intervention to carry the European revolution further; Mikhail Tukhachevsky commanded the 4th Army and was responsible for the main thrust towards Warsaw; Aleksandr Yegorov led the 3rd Army, Sergei Kamenev the 2nd Army, and Semyon Budyonny the 1st Cavalry Army on the southern flank.
kits: 任務單上的兵器是英國一八六二年前後的鐵甲艦。這個世代包括皇家主權號、光榮號、威靈敏親王號等遠洋鐵甲艦：木殼外面包上鐵帶，裝甲第一次比火砲更難對付，砲塔設計自此繞著裝甲帶轉；一八七〇年代的平甲鐵甲艦更把砲塔做成圓盤形。到一九一九年，這些船多已拆解或改充教練用途，但「裝甲優先」的邏輯由主力艦承續：一九二〇年波羅的海的實力對比寫的是主力艦世代的帳，真正在海上交手的則是裝甲巡洋艦、巡洋驅逐艦、監視堡壘與魚雷艇。波蘭海軍沒有任何鐵甲艦，其序列是一九二〇年在英國建造的巡洋驅逐艦「維希爾」號與「布爾查」號、裝甲雷擊艦「格魯夫」號、兩艘砲艇、一艘潛艇「迪克」號與數艘掃雷艦。陸戰方面，波軍以法製勒貝爾步槍為主軸，另大量使用德製毛瑟九八年式步槍、馬克西姆重機槍、七五公分野戰砲、一二〇公分重砲、七五與二二公分迫擊砲，以及法國援助的一九一六年式輕型戰車與雷諾 FT 型戰車，另有裝甲列車與裝甲汽車；一九二〇年六月的羅基特納一役中，裝甲列車與三輛雷諾 FT 戰車首次並肩作戰。航空方面有法製斯帕德十三式與英製布里斯托爾戰鬥機，志願飛行大隊人數超過一百五十。馬匹仍是主要機動與運輸工具，紅軍第一騎兵軍轄六個騎兵師，馬匹數以萬匹計。
kitsEn: The weapon named on the card is a British ironclad of about 1862. That generation comprised such ocean-going ships as HMS Royal Sovereign, HMS Warrior, HMS Prince Consort and HMS Defence: a wooden hull sheathed in iron, armour that for the first time was harder to defeat than the guns, and turret design that from then on was bent around the armoured belt; the flat-ironclads of the 1870s took the step further and gave the turret a circular plate. By 1919 most of these ships had been broken up or converted to training use, but the principle of armour first was carried on by the dreadnoughts, so that the balance of power in the Baltic in 1920 was written in dreadnought numbers, while the ships that actually met each other at sea were armoured cruisers, destroyers, monitors and torpedo boats. The Polish Navy had no ironclad at all. Its order of battle was the destroyers Wicher and Burza, built in Britain in 1920, the armoured minelayer Gryf, two gunboats, the submarine Dzik and a number of minesweepers. On land the Polish Army built its infantry around French Lebel rifles, adding large quantities of German Mauser 98 rifles, Maxim heavy machine guns, 75 mm field guns, 120 mm heavy howitzers, 75 mm and 220 mm mortars, and French-supplied 1916 light tanks and Renault FT tanks, with armoured trains and armoured cars in addition; in the fighting at Rokitna in June 1920 an armoured train and three Renault FT tanks fought side by side for the first time on the Polish front. In the air were French SPAD XIII and British Bristol fighters, with more than a hundred and fifty volunteer pilots. The horse remained the principal means of manoeuvre and transport, and the Red Army's 1st Cavalry Army alone fielded six cavalry divisions and tens of thousands of horses.
tactics: 一九一九年的戰線是零散的地方攻勢與據點爭奪：德國東境切申一帶的進攻戰、沃里尼亞的科韋爾與利沃夫外圍的拉齊明攻防、白俄羅斯別亞韋斯托克與布列斯特之間的拉鋸，波軍多採守點反擊，紅軍則以步兵師密集縱隊反覆衝擊。一九二〇年五月起，紅軍改採連續打擊的戰役法：第四軍自斯摩棱斯克—明斯克方向切入，砲兵與騎兵配合封鎖缺口，縱隊一日推進數十公里，企圖以連續衝擊把波軍防線壓碎；戰役縱隊突破之後不回頭鞏固，直接奔向華沙。波軍的對策是楔形突破：八月十三日以利沃夫—盧布林方向的中路縱隊配騎兵先鋒插入紅軍側翼，兩翼由步兵師在極短時間內展開成漫長的攻擊正面，同時北翼雷茲-希米格維部在馬托欽—科謝尼采方向反擊，切斷紅軍退路，八月二十五日紅軍自維斯瓦河東岸全面退卻。九月以後波軍轉入縱深追擊，熱利戈夫斯基以「鐵」行動奪維爾納，裝甲列車沿鐵路晝夜疾進，步兵師搭乘鐵路車廂調動，兵鋒一度抵達斯摩棱斯克近郊。掩護方面，雙方都大量使用野戰壕溝與掩體；紅軍撤退時執行焦土命令，炸毀鐵路與橋樑，把波軍拖入補給崩潰的追擊戰。補給線是兩軍真正的弱點：波軍靠維斯瓦河下游至但澤的鐵路與內陸公路輸送，紅軍靠橫貫俄國的寬軌鐵路，兩邊的馬車隊都在冬季雪封時斷過。
tacticsEn: The fighting of 1919 was a scatter of local attacks and struggles for fixed points: the offensive around Cieszyn in the eastern German territory, the defence of Kowel in Volhynia and the fighting outside Lvov around Radzymin, and the seesaw struggle between Bialystok and Brest in Belarus. The Polish Army mostly held its points and counter-attacked, while the Red Army hammered them with dense infantry columns. From May 1920 the Red Army changed to a war of continuous blows: the 4th Army cut in from the Smolensk-Minsk axis, with artillery and cavalry sealing the gaps, columns advancing tens of kilometres a day in the hope of grinding the Polish line to pieces; once a manoeuvre group had broken through it did not consolidate but drove straight on towards Warsaw. The Polish answer was the wedge: on 13 August a central column on the Lvov-Lublin axis, led by cavalry, drove into the flank of the Red Army, and on both sides infantry divisions spread out in very short order into a long attacking front, while on the northern wing the force of Rydz-Smigly struck back between Matocin and Kosienice, cutting the Red Army's road back, and on 25 August the Red Army fell back in full from the east bank of the Vistula. From September the Polish Army went over to pursuit in depth: Zeligowski took Vilnius in the operation code-named Zelazo, armoured trains ran day and night along the railway, infantry divisions were shifted in railway carriages, and the spearhead reached the outskirts of Smolensk. For cover both sides used field trenches and shelters extensively, and during the retreat the Red Army carried out scorched-earth orders, blowing up railways and bridges to drag the Polish Army into a pursuit it could not supply. The supply line was the real weakness of both: the Polish Army moved men and materiel by the railway from the lower Vistula to Danzig and by inland roads, while the Red Army relied on the broad-gauge railway running across Russia, and both sides' wagon trains were cut when the winter snow closed the roads.
data: 時間軸很清楚：一九一九年二月十四日開戰；一九二〇年四月底至五月初紅軍四路出手；七月十日紅軍占領明斯克；八月十二日至二十五日華沙會戰；九月十二日在卓爾切夫簽署停戰；十月十五日波軍占領維爾納；一九二一年三月十八日里加條約簽訂，五月一日生效。距離上，紅軍自明斯克推到華沙東郊約六百公里，八月撤退約三百公里，波軍十月反攻推進約六百公里至斯摩棱斯克近郊。兵力上，波蘭一九二〇年動員約一百萬人，華沙方向作戰兵力約五萬人，紅軍第四軍十萬人上下，全線紅軍作戰兵力約三十至四十萬，第一騎兵軍約三萬人。損耗上，波方陣亡與失蹤約一萬二千至一萬六千人、受傷約三萬餘人；紅軍陣亡人數各方估算由數萬至逾六萬不等，另有逾十萬名紅軍官兵因斑疹傷寒病倒，波軍病患亦以萬計。海軍方面，一九二〇年九月二十八日至二十九日赫爾海戰中，波蘭驅逐艦「維希爾」號與「布爾查」號以撞角擊沉蘇聯拖船「圖曼」號與「伊帕特」號，英法巡洋艦在場觀戰而未介入。援助與產能方面，一九二〇年法方交付的軍火約有九萬六千支步槍、二千挺機槍、二百五十餘門野戰砲、十八輛雷諾 FT 戰車與約二百架航空機，全部經但澤卸貨；波蘭自造的重砲彈仍大量仰賴進口。里加條約讓波蘭得到約二十五萬平方公里土地與約四百三十萬人口，一九二一年波蘭共和國面積約三十五萬平方公里、人口約三千一百萬。
dataEn: The chronology is clear: the war opened on 14 February 1919; the Red Army struck on four axes in late April and early May 1920; Minsk fell on 10 July; the battle for Warsaw ran from 12 to 25 August; an armistice was signed at Zolochiv on 12 September; the Poles took Vilnius on 15 October; and the Treaty of Riga was signed on 18 March 1921, taking effect on 1 May. As for distances, the Red Army pushed some six hundred kilometres from Minsk to the eastern outskirts of Warsaw, retreated about three hundred kilometres in August, and the Polish counter-offensive of October advanced roughly six hundred kilometres to the outskirts of Smolensk. On strength, Poland mobilised about one million men in 1920, with roughly fifty thousand in the fighting force facing Warsaw; the Red Army's 4th Army numbered around one hundred thousand, total Red Army forces on the Polish front between three hundred and four hundred thousand, and the 1st Cavalry Army about thirty thousand. As for losses, the Polish side lost some twelve to sixteen thousand dead and missing and more than thirty thousand wounded; estimates of Red Army dead range from several tens of thousands to over sixty thousand, and more than a hundred thousand Red Army men were laid low by typhus and other disease, while tens of thousands of Polish soldiers fell ill in the same way. At sea, in the fighting off Hel on 28 and 29 September 1920, the Polish destroyers Wicher and Burza rammed and sank the Soviet tugs Tuman and Ipat, while British and French cruisers stood by and did not intervene. As for aid and production, the French deliveries of 1920 came to roughly ninety-six thousand rifles, two thousand machine guns, some two hundred and fifty field guns, eighteen Renault FT tanks and about two hundred aircraft, all landed at Danzig; Poland's own output of heavy shells still depended largely on imports. The Treaty of Riga gave Poland about 250,000 square kilometres of territory and some 4.3 million people, and the Polish Republic of 1921 covered roughly 350,000 square kilometres with a population of about 31 million.
cause: 打起來有六層原因。第一，波蘭共和國一九一八年復國之後，急於重建通往波羅的海的出海通道與前俄屬西部疆土，凡爾賽條約把德國割讓的大波蘭與波森歸還波蘭，邊界問題因而成為可以再議的對象。第二，蘇維埃政權把波蘭資產階級國家視為反革命堡壘，紅軍在西線的推進本身就是革命輸出的手段，紅軍內部的革命戰爭理論就是要靠連續勝利把歐洲推向布爾什維克。第三，波蘭、烏克蘭、白俄羅斯與立陶宛的武裝衝突互相重疊，波蘭既與烏克蘭民族主義者交戰，又援助白俄羅斯境內的武裝，波蘭境內因此同時存在紅軍游擊與烏克蘭游擊。第四，協約國的介入與封鎖把波蘭戰爭變成列強的競技場：英法援助、波羅的海封鎖的部署與凡爾賽體系下的邊界方案，把波蘭推向對蘇俄開戰。第五，蘇俄的內戰尚在進行，俄國的物資與人力正被內戰消耗，但紅軍仍能集中兵力西進，因為蘇俄判斷波蘭是可以擊敗的。第六，海軍層面的現實是：波蘭國土被切成狹長的走廊，租借港與艦隊的處境極不穩定，位於波羅的海的英法主力艦與巡洋艦實際上決定了波蘭海軍的生存，而一九一八年以後仍殘存的鐵甲艦與主力艦世代，正是海上力量對比的基本單位。
causeEn: There were six layers of cause. First, after the Polish Republic was restored in 1918 it was in a hurry to rebuild access to the Baltic and to reclaim the western territories of the former Russian Empire, and the Versailles settlement, which returned Poznan and parts of Pomerania to Poland, left the frontier open to further argument. Second, the Soviet authorities treated the Polish bourgeois state as a counter-revolutionary fortress, and the Red Army's advance on the western front was itself a means of exporting the revolution; the doctrine of revolutionary war inside the Red Army meant that a run of victories was to push Europe towards Bolshevism. Third, the armed clashes of Poland, Ukraine, Belarus and Lithuania overlapped: Poland fought the Ukrainian nationalists while also backing armed groups in Belarus, so Red Army partisans and Ukrainian partisans operated inside Poland at the same time. Fourth, the intervention and blockade of the Entente turned the Polish war into an arena of the great powers; British and French aid, the deployment of the Baltic blockade and the frontier schemes of the Versailles system pushed Poland into war with Soviet Russia. Fifth, the Russian civil war was still running and the country's materiel and manpower were being consumed by it, yet the Red Army could still concentrate for the offensive to the west, because Moscow judged Poland beatable. Sixth, the naval reality was this: Poland's territory had been reduced to a narrow corridor, the status of its leased ports and its fleet was extremely precarious, and the British and French dreadnoughts and cruisers in the Baltic in fact decided whether the Polish Navy survived, while the surviving ironclads and the dreadnought generation remained the basic units of the maritime balance.
impact: 影響有遠有近。近的一層，波蘭以東境換來一段緩衝期：一九二〇年波軍奪得的加利西亞、維普日河下游、立陶宛南部與白俄羅斯西部，構成里加條約的基礎；波蘭人口在幾年之內多出數百萬少數民族，境內治理問題自此長期擱置，烏克蘭與白俄羅斯的武裝衝突也在沃里尼亞一帶延續成一九二〇年代的長期戰事。遠的一層，這場戰爭把紅軍的西進擋在維斯瓦河，也是歐洲革命浪潮的分水嶺：布爾什維克此後放棄立即向歐洲推進，改以國內建設為主；紅軍也從游擊式的短期軍正式定型為常備國防軍，一九二〇年十二月第五次黨代表大會把建立常備軍寫成正式方針。波蘭這邊則相反，軍隊成為國族認同的核心，維斯瓦河上的奇蹟被寫進官方敘事，一九二六年的薩納奇亞政變正是軍人政治影響力的頂點。制度面上，波蘭與蘇聯的邊界在東歐劃出一條長線，這條線與寇松線大體重合，一九三九年德蘇邊界條約劃出的分割線正是沿著它切開波蘭；而波蘭的出海口問題——格但斯克自由市與波羅的海走廊——同樣被推遲到一九三九年才爆發，其間波蘭海軍主力寄泊英國，形成波英海軍合作長達二十年的傳統。
impactEn: The effects were both immediate and long-range. In the near term Poland bought itself a buffer with its eastern territories: the Galicia, the lower Vistula, southern Lithuania and western Belarus that the Polish Army took in 1920 formed the basis of the Treaty of Riga, and the population of Poland grew within a few years by several million members of minorities, leaving the problem of governing them unresolved for decades, while the armed clash between Ukrainian and Belarusian groups continued in Volhynia and became a long war through the 1920s. In the longer term this war checked the Red Army's drive to the west on the Vistula and became the watershed of the European revolutionary tide: the Bolsheviks then abandoned the immediate push into Europe and turned to building at home, and the Red Army was formally reconstituted from a short-term partisan force into a permanent national army, with the establishment of a standing army written into the resolutions of the Fifth Party Congress in December 1920. In Poland the tendency ran the other way: the army became the core of national identity, the miracle on the Vistula was written into official narrative, and the Sanacja coup of 1926 marked the high point of military politics. Institutionally, the Polish-Soviet border drew a long line across eastern Europe that substantially coincides with the Curzon Line, and it was along that line that the demarcation drawn by the German-Soviet boundary agreement of 1939 cut Poland in two; the outlet question, the Free City of Danzig and the Baltic corridor, was likewise deferred to 1939, and in the interval the Polish Navy lay in British ports, creating a tradition of Polish-British naval cooperation lasting twenty years.
result: 結果是一份條約，而不是一場殲滅戰。一九二〇年九月十二日的停戰線大致沿用寇松線，一九二一年三月十八日在里加簽訂的條約把波蘭東界正式寫下：波蘭保有加利西亞全境、喀爾巴阡山麓、維斯瓦河下游與華沙，並取得維爾納周邊與白俄羅斯西部大片地區；蘇維埃俄國承認波蘭的獨立與這條邊界，同時放還被帶往蘇聯的波蘭兒童，並允許波方掘取米沃什與其他波蘭民族英雄的遺骸回國。紅軍退回蘇俄境內，兵力在同年三月再度集結，向西發動一次大規模攻勢卻在別列津河一線受挫，隨即在克朗施塔得發生水兵與士兵的起義，一九二一年夏蘇俄轉入新生產政策。波蘭方面取得想要的疆界，卻付出慘重代價：軍隊大裁員，傷患與病患拖垮經濟，境內少數民族問題在往後二十年成為內政主線，一九二一年五月德國共產黨人並在較大的西里西亞地區發動武裝起事，波軍奉命參與鎮壓。戰爭結束時波蘭海軍主力仍寄泊英國，直到一九二二年才駛回。
resultEn: The outcome was a treaty rather than an annihilation. The armistice line of 12 September 1920 largely followed the Curzon Line, and the treaty signed at Riga on 18 March 1921 wrote the Polish eastern frontier down in binding form: Poland kept all of Galicia, the Carpathian foothills, the lower Vistula and Warsaw, and acquired large areas around Vilnius and in western Belarus; Soviet Russia recognised Polish independence and that frontier, at the same time returning the Polish children taken to the Soviet Union and allowing the Polish side to exhume Mickiewicz and other national heroes for return home. The Red Army withdrew into Soviet territory, concentrated again in March of the same year and launched a large offensive to the west that was checked on the Berezina, after which the Kronstadt mutiny of sailors and soldiers broke out, and Soviet Russia turned to the New Economic Policy in the summer of 1921. Poland obtained the frontier it wanted at heavy cost: the army was cut back sharply, the wounded and the sick weighed on the economy, the minority question became the main line of domestic politics for the following twenty years, and in May 1921 the German communists rose in the larger part of Silesia, with the Polish Army taking part in the suppression. At the end of the war the bulk of the Polish Navy still lay in British harbours and did not sail home until 1922.
